dedupe_keys.name: river and stream water quality for cso program

description: The City of Winnipeg publishes river and stream water-quality samples collected for its combined sewer overflow programme. Coverage includes the Red and Assiniboine rivers and selected streams under specified wet and dry conditions in 2014, 2015, 2023 and 2024. Fields include sample location, event, date, time, temperature, oxygen, nutrients, suspended solids and bacterial indicators. This programme-specific monitoring can support evaluation of receiving-water effects in sewer-overflow simulation. It differs from the existing CSO discharge dataset, which samples the outfalls themselves. The provider distinguishes field analysis, laboratory calculation and contract-laboratory tests. N/A marks unavailable results, while less-than and greater-than signs identify detection-limit censoring. These values must not be treated as ordinary exact measurements. Coverage follows the provider-described Winnipeg system. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The standard licence field names the Canada Open Government Licence, while custom metadata names the Winnipeg licence. Their equivalence is unverified. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related CSO discharge samples describe overflow points.
